description: Draws one or more screens on a new page of the Figma file the designer has open, as editable auto-layout frames. Pass several screens to compare options side by side on one page. Every draw makes a new page, so it never changes the designer's work. The Better Design plugin must be open in that file, and the designer approves each draw in its panel, where each screen's address or file name is shown. For React, a Shopify store or Expo web, pass a rendered page: url when the server renders it, or path to a saved .html copy when only the browser does. Add data-part="Button" to an element to make it an instance of the file's component of that name, on any page of the file. Add data-part-key with a component's key from read-figma-kit to use a published library component that this file does not hold. For SwiftUI or native React Native, write a .json layout tree and pass it as path: each node has t (frame, text, svg or part), n, x, y, w, h, and optional fill, stroke, r, layout, text, part, key and ch (its children). x and y are measured from the top left corner of the node's parent, in pixels. A colour is [red, green, blue, alpha], each from 0 to 1. text is { s: the words, f: font family, wt: weight, sz: size, lh: line height or null, ls: letter spacing, c: colour, al: LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT or JUSTIFIED }. Take positions from the simulator and colours and fonts from the source.

name.description: The name of the new Figma page.

baseUrl.description: With an .html path only: the address the page was saved from, so its /assets links resolve. Omit to resolve them beside the file.

height.description: The height to render a web page at, in pixels. Defaults to 900. Not for a .json tree.

name.description: The option's name, shown on its frame in Figma, such as "Dense".

path.description: A saved .html or .htm file with the page's rendered HTML, or a .json layout tree for a screen that is not on the web.

url.description: The address of a running page whose HTML the server already renders. Use path for an app that renders only in the browser.

width.description: The width to render a web page at, in pixels. Defaults to 1440. Not for a .json tree.

name: draw-in-figma
title: Draw screens in Figma
